requirement_summary: 02_FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_PROGRAMS.md NFR-OBS: 'Trace, Metric, Structured Log. 검증: 모든 Workflow Operation 실행이 Trace ID로 상호 연결 가능해야 하며, 최소 필드셋(operation, actor, duration, decision, evidence_ref)을 포함한 구조화 로그를 남겨야 한다.'
subject: SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.structuredLogCompletenessCheck via assurance.observability.structured-log-completeness-check; contracts/structured-log-completeness-check.v1.schema.json (NEW)
coverage_notes: The 5 named minimum fields (operation/actor/duration/decision/evidence_ref) are required structurally on every entry. Beyond presence, two real checks close the requirement's own further claims: structuredLogCompletenessCheckDetectsAnEntryNotCorrelatedToTheDeclaredTrace is the direct test of '상호 연결 가능해야 한다' (must be mutually correlatable) -- an entry carrying a DIFFERENT trace_id value than the one declared for the batch is caught by real string equality, not merely checked for presence of some trace_id field. structuredLogCompletenessCheckDetectsANegativeDuration proves duration is checked as a real, structurally-sane numeric measurement (a negative duration is physically impossible and rejected), not just a required-but-unvalidated field.
open_gap: Operates on a caller-supplied batch of already-produced log entries; there is no live logging/tracing infrastructure in this codebase that actually emits structured log entries from real Workflow Operation executions and feeds this gate automatically (same disclosed 'caller-supplied representation, not live system integration' pattern as every other real-computation closure this session). The requirement's own field-set is disclosed as still DRAFT (08_REVIEW_CHECKLIST_OPEN_DECISIONS.md C11) -- this closure commits to the specific 5 fields the requirement text itself names, not a speculative superset.
